notes: READ THE ASK CAREFULLY: this is not a request for an answer to send back. lamontae's instruction, 2026-09-22 16:17:33Z, verbatim: "tell chatgpt to think about and ask me a question about the political violence." He wants the question worked first and then put to him, not handed to him cold.

That is the standing pattern in this project. Design questions reach him through ChatGPT already worked, with the options laid out and a recommendation, so that what he is asked to do is decide rather than design. Answering this one back to us would be the wrong deliverable and would use up the only thing worth asking him for.
Filed by the research queue lane at his instruction.
question: Work this question and then put it to lamontae yourself, rather than answering it to us. Your C09 answer says to keep political violence rare, to keep the canonical threat and intent prerequisites, and to use no random timer — and it leaves open whether the player may be the one who initiates it. He has read that and asked, in his own words, that you "think about and ask me a question about the political violence." So: think it through, then ask him the one question that actually decides it. What that question is, is yours to work out; what it must do is present him with real alternatives and their consequences, in a form he can answer in a sentence, with your own recommendation marked.

title: Political violence: work the question, then ask him
usableAnswer: A question put to lamontae directly, in your own channel, with the alternatives and what each one costs, and your recommendation marked. Not a position paper, and not an answer returned to us to relay.
whyItMatters: It is the one place in the whole stress-test batch where you declined to decide and referred the matter up, and he has agreed that it is his to decide — but he has asked to be asked properly. This is also the subject where getting it wrong is least recoverable: what a game lets a player do to a public figure is a statement about the game, and it is much easier to add later than to withdraw.
